newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Police arrest 50 beggars in Colombo on suspicion of spying for the LTTE.
LTTE fighters clear mines in Pooneryn after army withdraws camp; warn people not to enter area.
Police search offices of Tamil groups in Trincomalee after killing of police officer.
World Bank and International Monetary Fund promise Sri Lanka extra $600 million in next two years, Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris says.
Government forces, Tamil rebels to have truce during anti-polio campaign in northeast.
Government plans to take back arms supplied to former Tamil rebel groups now supporting security forces after reports of their alleged involvement in series of recent crimes.
Security tightened in Mannar after intelligence reports of possible Tamil Tiger rebel attack.
Air force bombs Tamil Tiger rebel base in Mullaitivu jungles.
